gizmo.title: Indawo yokulahla esithombeni
gizmo.description: Abafundi babeka amalebula ezindaweni ezibekwe phezu kwesithombe, bese behlola impendulo yabo.

configure.title: Umbhalo ongenye indlela
configure.description: Ichaza isithombe kubantu abangakwazi ukusibona. Ungadaluli ukuthi amalebula aya kuphi.

configure.title: Isihloko sesithombe
configure.description: Isihloko esifushane esibonakalayo sesithombe, esiboniswa ngaphezulu kwaso.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abacelwa ukuthi bakwenze ngamalebula.

configure.title: Amalebula nezindawo
configure.description: Into ngayinye iyilebula abafundi abangayibeka. Nika ilebula igama lendawo ukuze ubeke indawo yayo esithombeni; ilebula engenalo igama lendawo iyinto eyengeziwe engeyona yandawo. Izinombolo zezindawo zingamaphesenti esithombe.

configure.title: Okushiwo ngesithombe
configure.description: Okushiwo ngesithombe okungakhethwa okuboniswa ngaphansi kwesithombe.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Izikhathi umfundi angahlola ngazo. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo.

advanced.title: Shova amalebula
advanced.description: Bonisa amalebula ngokulandelana okuhlukile njalo uma kuvakashelwa.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomugqa ovuleka futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eseduze nawo.

advanced.title: Qala kugoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomethi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomethi yokumaka yalokhu kuhlola (isb. amaphuzu, uhlamvu, amaphesenti, ukuqedwa).

advanced.title: Inhloso yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: inhloso yokufunda ehlobene nalokhu kuhlola.

developer.title: Igama lequizi
developer.description: Igama lequizi elisetshenziselwa ukuhlonza kwe-xAPI ezinhlelweni zokuhlaziya.

developer.title: Isifundo
developer.description: OER Schema: isifundo lokhu kuhlola okuhloselwe sona.
